system.description:
Your machine nature gives you adaptability and firepower.

Powers/Qualities

Assign one or more of the dice you rolled at the end of the power source step to any of these powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• Select from Athletic powers category

• Select from Intellectual powers category

• Select from Mobility powers category

• Select from Self Control powers category

• Select from Technological powers category

Assign any remaining dice to any of these qualities:

• Select from Information qualities category

• Select from Mental qualities category

Assign a d10 to a Technological power you do not already possess.

Abilities

Gain two of the following Green abilities, using two different powers:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.nxy5L8mxhSKfBKAa]{Adaptive Programming}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.TYRZ8Y4qvEtEt25N]{Living Arsenal}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.GHCsdSDslA2nGCKQ]{Metal Skin}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.3yGCDIiLKkbsIXgN]{Self-Improvement}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.sQcljCLUHC9mfoPa]{Something for Everyone}

Gain one of the above abilities at Yellow.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.YjenR52LBy44MSPD]{Adaptive Programming}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.ViCkNQBpTJxixj0K]{Living Arsenal}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.kp1KchlKzojAJhqv]{Metal Skin}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.hfXn4607y3pBRpKD]{Self-Improvement}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.kUlShLzWMzwYaZJp]{Something for Everyone}
Principle

Choose an Expertise principle.

Additional Info

When determining Health during step 7, you may use a Technological power instead of an Athletic power or Mental quality.

Personality

Roll d10, d10 for personality selection.
